tentang.title: About Koperasi Bulau Ngandung
tentang.artiNamaDesc: “Bulau Ngandung” comes from the Dayak Ngaju language. Bulau means gold or wealth, while Ngandung means remembrance or eternal memory. This name was chosen because the Kapuas forest is a treasure that must be remembered, protected, and passed on — not cut down and forgotten.

kebijakanPrivasi.title: Privacy Policy
kebijakanPrivasi.pengantar: Koperasi Bulau Ngandung ('we', 'the cooperative') is committed to protecting the privacy of users of this website. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your personal information.
kebijakanPrivasi.section1Content1: We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide when using this website, including:
kebijakanPrivasi.section1List4: Messages you submit through the contact form
kebijakanPrivasi.section1List5: Information provided when subscribing to our newsletter
kebijakanPrivasi.section1Content2: We also automatically collect usage data through cookies and other tracking technologies, including IP address, browser type, pages visited, and visit duration.
kebijakanPrivasi.section2Content: The information we collect is used to:
kebijakanPrivasi.section2List1: Respond to your inquiries and messages
kebijakanPrivasi.section2List2: Send newsletters and updates (with your consent)
kebijakanPrivasi.section2List3: Improve our services and website user experience
kebijakanPrivasi.section2List4: Comply with applicable legal obligations and regulations
kebijakanPrivasi.section3Content: We implement reasonable technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure.
kebijakanPrivasi.section4Content: We do not sell, trade, or transfer your personal information to third parties without your consent, except:
kebijakanPrivasi.section4List2: To protect the rights, property, or safety of the cooperative
kebijakanPrivasi.section4List3: To trusted service providers who assist us in operating the website (under confidentiality agreements)
kebijakanPrivasi.section5List1: Access the personal data we hold about you
kebijakanPrivasi.section5List2: Request correction or deletion of your personal data
kebijakanPrivasi.section5List3: Withdraw consent for data processing at any time
kebijakanPrivasi.section5List4: Lodge a complaint with the relevant data protection authority
kebijakanPrivasi.section6Content: Our website uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience. You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings. Cookies we use include session cookies and analytics cookies to understand how users interact with our site.
kebijakanPrivasi.section7Content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with the update date listed at the top.
kebijakanPrivasi.section8Content: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at:
kebijakanPrivasi.section8Address: Address: Kapuas Regency, Central Kalimantan, Indonesia
